post.description:
Get the latest prices for the given token addresses.
Returns price information including timestamp, price, open, high, close, low, and volume.
Args:
    payloads: List of PayloadTokenAddress objects containing token addresses and chains
Returns:
    Dictionary mapping chain types to lists of PayloadTokenAddress objects
Example:
    ```
    [
        {
            "token_address": "1Qf8gESP4i6CFNWerUSDdLKJ9U1LpqTYvjJ2MM4pain",
            "chain": "solana"
        }
    ]
    ```
Get a list of historical token prices by chain and token address for a given time range and granularity.
Get the stats for the given token addresseses.

EVMAddress.title: EVMAddress
EVMAddress.description:
Initialize an address `EVMAddress(value="0xd8da6bf26964af9d7eed9e03e53415d37aa96045")`.

The address will automatically be converted to lower case.

Addresses are valid if they are a string. For additional validation use the `is_address` method


Deserialize an address from a string
```
addr = EVMAddress.model_validate("0xd8da6bf26964af9d7eed9e03e53415d37aa96045")
>>> addr.value # 0xd8da6bf26964af9d7eed9e03e53415d37aa96045
```


Deserialize an address from an object
```
addr = EVMAddress.model_validate({"value": "0xd8da6bf26964af9d7eed9e03e53415d37aa96045"})
>>> addr.value # 0xd8da6bf26964af9d7eed9e03e53415d37aa96045
```


Serialize an address to it's string form (default)
```
addr = EVMAddress(value="0xd8da6bf26964af9d7eed9e03e53415d37aa96045")
>>> addr.model_dump() # 0xd8da6bf26964af9d7eed9e03e53415d37aa96045
```

Format string
```
addr = EVMAddress(value="0xd8da6bf26964af9d7eed9e03e53415d37aa96045")
>>> f"{addr}" # 0xd8da6bf26964af9d7eed9e03e53415d37aa96045
```
